items.name: Eturnull Hat
items.description: A dark conical traveling hat of the Eternal Scribe. From its silver-blue brim, unfinished mathematics falls, gathers into equations, and fades. Cosmetic headpiece.

items.name: Eturnull Manuscript
items.description:
A Grimoire recovered from the creator of a world that never needed to exist.
Its pages contain no spells, only expressions describing what already is.
The quill does not command reality.
It merely corrects the equation.
